async function toggle(book, button){if(!token()){status.textContent='Please log in to add books to your wishlist.';document.getElementById('loginBtn')?.click();return;}button.disabled=true;try{const r=await fetch(`/api/wishlist/${book.book_id}`,{method:book.wishlisted?'DELETE':'POST',headers:auth()});const x=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(x.message);book.wishlisted=x.wishlisted;button.textContent=x.wishlisted?'♥ In Wishlist':'♡ Add to Wishlist';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',x.wishlisted);status.textContent=x.message;}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message;}finally{button.disabled=false;}}

async function loadCategories(){try{const r=await fetch('/api/categories');if(!r.ok)throw Error('Unable to load categories');categories=await r.json();renderCategories();}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message;}finally{categoryGrid.setAttribute('aria-busy','false');}}

function renderBooks(books,total){booksGrid.replaceChildren();status.textContent=`${total} books`;books.forEach(book=>{const card=el('article','catalog-book');card.append(cover(book));const body=el('div','catalog-book__body');body.append(el('small','',book.category_name||'Uncategorized'),el('h2','',book.title));if(book.isbn)body.append(el('p','',`ISBN: ${book.isbn}`));body.append(el('p','',book.description||'No description available.'));body.append(el('p',Number(book.available_copies)?'availability available':'availability unavailable',Number(book.available_copies)?`Available — ${book.available_copies} copies`:'Currently unavailable'));const actions=el('div','book-actions');const detail=el('a','catalog-button','View Details');detail.href=`/book.html?id=${book.book_id}`;const wish=el('button','catalog-button wishlist-button',book.wishlisted?'♥ In Wishlist':'♡ Add to Wishlist');wish.setAttribute('aria-pressed',Boolean(book.wishlisted));wish.onclick=()=>toggle(book,wish);actions.append(detail,wish);body.append(actions);card.append(body);booksGrid.append(card);});if(!books.length)status.textContent='No books are currently available in this category.';}
